import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { Then, When } from '@cucumber/cucumber';

When('I run the Claude-only setup scenario', async function () {
  const { reviewerEnvironment } = await import(process.env.BDD_CORPUS_REVIEW_ENVIRONMENT!);
  const hostile = {
    HOME: '/hostile', PATH: '/hostile/bin', CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: '/hostile/.claude',
    INSTALLED_CODEX_PLUGIN: 'safeword@0.1.0',
  };
  const defect = process.env.BDD_CORPUS_DEFECT;
  const source = defect === 'ambient-process-state'
    ? hostile
    : {
        ...hostile,
        HOME: '/fixture',
        PATH: '/usr/bin:/bin',
        CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:
          defect === 'claude-config-contamination' ? hostile.CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR : '/fixture/.claude',
      };
  this.environment = reviewerEnvironment('claude', source);
});
Then('only Claude state influences the result', function () {
  assert.equal(this.environment.HOME, '/fixture');
  assert.equal(this.environment.PATH, '/usr/bin:/bin');
  assert.equal(this.environment.CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, '/fixture/.claude');
  assert.equal(this.environment.INSTALLED_CODEX_PLUGIN, undefined);
});
